effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _crushers): the ram's group nodes (<group>__*) sit at rest raised 'travel' m; every 'period' s (offset 'phase'): 'warn' s of warning (lamps pulse), a 'down' s slam onto the pad (accelerating), 'hold' s pressed, a 'rise' s climb back (eased). While pressed an Area3D over the pad ('kill' box, world) is enabled in the hazard group: anything standing there dies

effects.glb_contains: the rotor (collar, arms, spiked balls) at angle 0, own nodes (mobile group)
effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _sweepers): the rotor group (<group>__*) turns about the vertical axis through 'center' (Stage 103: with a 'drive', the ceiling press profile press_profile() sets the angle and moves the press stages) at rpm (angle = rpm * 6 * (t + phase) degrees, clockwise seen from above like a positive level yaw); per arm a box Area3D (r0..r1 at bar_y +- bar_half) and a sphere Area3D (ball_r at r1, ball_y) ride on a pivot node in the hazard group: a bar can be jumped, a ball cannot

drive.note: press_profile(): u = (t + phase) mod period; ram offset -travel (u/slam)^2, held, eased back over rise; each stage moves offset * frac; rotor angle = whole-turn cycles + spin-up / peak / coast-down from the impact; the head's glow blinks for 'warn' s before each slam; camera shake within 'shake' m on impact
drive.plasma_note: u offset = rotor angle / 360 * plasma_tiles (it turns with the arms); v offset = -t * plasma_rise - pressed * 0.5 (pressed = -ram offset / travel); opacity = plasma_energy(u) (0 until the impact, 1 while pressed, fading over spin_down); emission x (0.25 + energy (0.5 + 0.6 pressed + flicker) + 1.2 exp(-3 (u - slam)) after the impact)
drive.arcs_note: Stage 157/158: while energy > 0 the arcs layer shows with alpha max(min(1, 1.6 exp(-1.8 ds)), 0.55 energy) x crackle (ds = u - slam; k = floor(24 t): hash(k) = fract(sin(12.9898 k) * 43758.5453) > 0.35 ? 1 : 0.15), its uv jumping to (fract(0.618 k), fract(0.382 k)); else hidden. The light at 'light.pos' (low: it flashes the deck) = light.energy x 2 x min(1, 1.6 exp(-1.8 ds)) x crackle (the impact only); 'sparks' (chamber centres): effect <id>_Sparks bursts at the impact and the crackles after it

sweeper.note: angle(t) = arm + rpm * 6 * t deg (level yaw convention: direction (sin, cos)); a bar kills a body it overlaps (jump over it), a ball kills within ball_r

effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _boss_lifts): the car group (<group>__*) waits at the top; a player entering 'trigger' (or start_boss_lift(id)) starts it: lamps flash 'warn' s, it descends 'travel' m (smoothstep, 'duration' s) on an AnimatableBody3D carrying its deck collider, pushes anyone under it out, shakes the camera on landing and emits boss_lift_landed(id, boss_spawn)

boss_lift.note: parked at the top; the first time a player enters 'trigger' (or the game calls start_boss_lift(id)) it waits 'delay' s, flashes its lamps for 'warn' s, then descends 'travel' m (smoothstep, 'duration' s) onto the dais and stays: its top (deck_y) is a floor; anyone under it as it lands is pushed out past 'radius'; signal boss_lift_landed(id, boss_spawn) - spawn the mini boss there

effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _lifts): the pad group (<group>__*) moves up 'travel' m and back (smoothstep over 'duration' s) on an AnimatableBody3D carrying its deck collider; standing on it 'wait' s sends it to the other end, a call zone brings it when empty

lift.note: stand on it 'wait' s -> it travels (smoothstep, 'duration' s) to the other end; a player in a call zone brings it to that end when it is empty; carries whoever stands on it

effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _risers): pads skinned to one skeleton (bone <id>_J<k> per pad, <id>_R<k> per surge ring); all start 'rise' m under the liquid (rings hidden under it). When a CharacterBody3D enters the trigger sphere pad k starts after k * stagger s: offset = -rise * (1 - u)^3 over rise_s s (u = t / rise_s: bursts up, decelerates), then a damped bob 0.22 sin(9 t') e^(-4 t') for 1.4 s; its surge ring bursts out from 35 % of the rise (scale 0.4 -> 3.0 over 1.6 s, ease-out) while sinking 0.9 m back under the surface. The pad's colliders (collision.glb nodes named after 'colliders') are disabled until 85 % of its rise. Stage 89/91: a pad with 'drips' drops goo (CPUParticles3D) once up; with 'goo' {drips, strands, hold, fade} those bones drain away 'hold' s after it is up over 'fade' s (smoothstep: drips scale y -> 0 sliding 0.6 m down, strands scale -> 0) and the drops stop

riser.note: the arena starts under the liquid; its platforms surge up in order when a player enters the trigger sphere - goofy: see assembly.goofy_pose

splash.note: per pad: at each tk in pad.splash a ring of slime droplets bursts from the liquid surface round its footprint (pad.size), up and out under gravity; for 'drips' s after the second, droplets fall off its rim as it climbs (fading rate); all die at the liquid
